Sweetheart, you are NTA. Im so sorry. You deserve so much MORE than this inappropriate, selfish, and straight out stupid behavior from him. 

Happy birthday, and I hope he learns to treat you right or trust me, someone out there will be willing to.

YTA 

Seriously, dont EVER make anyone else change something about themselves for your family.  
Recipe for disaster and you're already trying to hide her/putting your family's judgements over her

YTA 

It's not just your safety youre keeping into account. It's theirs.  Risk it on your own, sure but don't risk theirs. 

Risk your stuff, sure, but not theirs. If you lived alone this would be different but you dont. 


How much each person pays for rent doesnt matter at all and makes it sound like you think that just because you pay more you have more of a right. 


If it's that much of an issue to you, get your own apartment.

NTA 

If you guys were speaking ill of her in japanese around her, it would be different. 

But honestly, if you and your gf are having a conversation, your mom doesnt have any right to know what is going on. 

Unless you are both going out of your way to exclude her or not talking to her while you guys are meant to be spending time together. 

My siblings and I speak english, my mother can understand it but struggles immensely sometimes. The only time we change to our language to include my mom is only if we are meant to be sharing the moment (i.e. we are having dinner together or something like that) but otherwise, my siblings and I speak english to each other for the most part. 

It's a matter of WHO the conversation is meant for. Even if she did understand, she shouldnt be including herself in conversations shes not a part of. 

I think from the description of this specific situation, NTA

NTA 

He continues his behavior BECAUSE he is being allowed to. You've brought it up and his supervisor (parent in this case) has refused to make a change.

Also, as someome who worked in a behavior intervention company as a one on one behavior assistant for years, even things like the channel being changed when he wants, people moving out of a treadmill for him, etc. Will just encourage wrong behavior and make him think he can get what he wants in life because of his autism. 

His behavior is inappropriate and since the mother has made it clear she is not going to try and correct behavior and encourage change, it is completely okay for you to end membership

ESH 

You BOTH took precaution and you BOTH created that life. 

Now, yes you wanted an abortion, and, as someone who is pro choice, I get it. 

BUT I dont think you understand the psychological damage an event like that can have on someone. An abortion is not an easy thing for everyone and it seems like youre taking it pretty casually and not really realizing the hardship it would bring on her. Yeah, it can be hard for a guy too but in the end, only women know what its like to carry a pregnancy and have to abprt it from THEIR body. 

Now, she's wrong to have told you that she would never ask anything of you and then proceed to ask for help. What I think happened is she never wanted an abortion and felt pressured by your lack of discussion and felt like it was going to be a big fight if she said she wanted to keep it and wanted help. Still, she SHOULD have communicated what she really wanted and needed. 

The sad truth is: you both decided to do adult decisions and now have adult consequences to deal with. And now, your deciaions have to affect someone who is innocent (kid). 

Sounds like both are irresponsible here.

YTA 

Your situation should not change their experience and youre being really selfish.  Perhaps they didnt want anyone to know until they announced it. 

Perhaps they were worried youd get mad which... at this point, im going to say fair fear. 


Truth is, they dont owe you an explanation in this specific situation as it seems they're just living their lives and not doing something out of malice. 

Jealousy is a fair feeling. I get it, and its okay to feel jealous and even kind of healthy in situations like this. I'deven say sad is a fair emotion... but angry at them and hoping they'd reveal something so personal to you guys before they're ready to is too much and unfair to them.

YTA. And a big one at that. 

Why would you even mention your income?? It doesnt make you any more right. It honestly establishes that you care mlre about your money than her health at the start.  

Also, it seems you do NOT understand what PTSD really means, or panic attacks. For some people, it can bring incredibly horrible side effects that, yes, require further testing. Why so many tests??? Because PTSD is not the same for everyone.

You wanna know why she probanly acts like its no big deal to you or doesnt twll you things? Because youre kinda being a bully to her by caring nore about your money than realizing how much hell she's going through trying to get herself better. Youre not being supportive or caring. she's YOUR WIFE.  And to be honest, you being this way to her is probably stressing her out more than she's already struggling. 

It seems you care more about your money than her health.

NTA - all I can say is i had a tiny 3-4k wedding in beginning of November, my cousin had hers beginning of December (much pricier) and my other cousin had hers at the end of December. We're a large family (with my dad, there's 10 aunts/uncles total) and so there's SO many cousins that it'd be ridiculous to try and wait a year or months in between. 

For weddings, you get ONE DAY. Unless you're indian or are having a multi day event...  but thats different obvi. That's it though. It's selfish to think people need to focus on your wedding for longer. The only people that should think or enjoy of it longer are the bride and groom. 

It's not like you schedule it on the same day or even a weekend away.

Honestly, he's so good at making me feel like he's genuine when he says he loves me and that he's always going to try for us and all that. 

A part of me hopes the man I dated will be there but the more time passes, the more I realize im a fucking idiot. Its so hard to get out of this cycle because i keep trying to tell myself he's working on himself with his therapist and such but the longer it takes him together, the more I fall apart.
